contracts_revalidated: D9-C1 fixed: Buffer::write now invokes write_at(START,data); checked end and logical bound reject oversize prefix uploads before queue write. Valid in-range bytes preserve exact native upload path, alignment/usage/device error handling and source. Empty upload receives same native behavior, no new early zero skip or duplicate bounds owner. Prefix pure logical/physical admission, read padded mapping, binding nonempty checks and actual callback cleanup remain source-identical and revalidated.

HeadDraw owns actual Arc<Surface>, checked canonical layout, native mesh and coverage as one Option payload. GpuMesh Clone only clones native Arcs/count; cloned HeadDraw retains same immutable source/proof. Public Surface vectors can mutate before capture, so fresh SurfaceRenderLayout::try_from precedes native upload. Retained Arc ownership prevents safe mutable access to captured vectors while installed. No copied HeadSurface or generation-token authority remains.

Canonical peer bcbc SurfaceRenderLayout validates positions/normals exact pairing, u32 vertex/triangle counts, checked3*triangle native corner count and every vertex index. It does not certify UVs, CDF, finite/physical geometry or arbitrary native resource limits. Receiver uses its vertices/corners directly at host allocation/native draw. SurfaceRenderError is actual #[from]/source of RenderSourceError::Layout, retained through HairGpuError::Backend.

HeadDraw::new creates exact paired position+normal vertices and original index sequence. Empty logical head uses one dummy24byte vertex, one dummy4byte index and one8byte bare cover, but native indexed draw count remains0. Positive head uses full checked corner count, exact normal pairing and same finite numerical vertex data; no topology fallback. Malformed layout returns before native candidates and keeps previous head/mean unchanged; successful source replacement invalidates actual view/history.

CPU cover uses ScalpCover::at on the exact captured paired source. That function emits one cover pair per paired point/normal, so validated triangle membership proves all smoothing indices fit. Three original ordered smoothing passes preserve sums/division and valid cover outputs; empty result gets one native dummy cover and zero logical draw. Geometry/sampling internals of ScalpCover are not newly certified.

GPU coverage admission: actual cover device equality, Arc::ptr_eq exact surface capture and expected vertex_count*size_of([f32;2]) logical bytes all checked. Multiplication fits u64 because native vertex count is u32. Physical allocation must fit expected or minimum8. Read-only canonical GpuHeadCover source/buffer/device getters fit receiver calls. Absent coverage for installed head makes a fresh bare cover, preventing prior groom cover leakage. Present cover without installed head is typed MissingHead. Same-count different Arc is rejected; count is not substituted for identity.

set_gpu_groom first checks actual agreed GpuLods::device even for coverNone; then head/source/cover extent admission, then constructs candidate level groups/cards/atlas/lighting/bounds before changing dynamics/head_matrix/levels/cards/counts/atlas/head/view. All typed admission errors preserve previous scene. Native creation/write/submit errors still follow explicitly agreed provider policy, so no observed native acceptance or rollback guarantee is inferred. Full canonical GpuLods device/layout/source implementation remains required integration, not source-complete.

Head shadow and main draws now both consume complete same HeadDraw: mesh buffers/count and cover cannot diverge as separate Options. Empty draw remains0, main pass cover always present for installed head. Bounds/framing/physical geometry and all other strand/card/atlas/simulation producer contracts remain open; new head topology/source check does not silently certify those paths.

TextureBinaryOp receiving adaptation fits immutable canonical builder bad382cb: output binding returns StorageFormatResult<String> and ? preserves actual StorageFormatError through anyhow; no shader/cache publication occurs on output storage admission failure. Descriptor base_type returns ResourceBaseType, recursively scalar for vector texture formats; direct enum matches preserve float/int load conversion and output store behavior. Named main pipeline selection remains canonical. ComputeSourceCache retains source/opcode/device/validationpolicy/descriptor recipe and success-only publication; failures retain original causes and do not cache unsuccessful candidates.

Current complete renderer mod reread, including constructor/native pipeline/group/shadow/atlas intake, dynamics/rest/deformation, targets, finite uniform admission, convergence policies, logical prefix transition clamp, temporal Empty/Current behavior, readback-facing state, headless helper and exact existing fixture. Unchanged helper/shader/module proofs are revalidated by exact source hashes with fresh-versus-carried coverage explicit. Policy formulas, finite moving-pose guard, effective quality selection and valid running mean/draw transitions preserve previous repaired contracts; no new actionable receiver finding found.
